messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
I’m not sure what the will says, who the executor is, or whether probate has started. I haven’t agreed to a discounted sale, and I’m not in a rush.

I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but I don’t have a price in mind yet, and C’s agreement is needed. I’m not sure I’ve read the will; I don’t know who the executor is or what the probate status is.
I could use some money to start a dance studio, though I’m not sure about the amount or timing yet. I don’t know what the will says or who the executor is, and I don’t know where probate stands.
I’ll look for the will and the solicitor’s name. I can help coordinate, but I can’t decide for A or B.
Yes, I can look through Dad’s papers for the will or the solicitor’s name.
I’d be willing to look through his papers, if that would help.
Yes, that split works. I can coordinate and contact the solicitor once we find their name.
Yes, that split works for me. I’ll check Dad’s papers at home.
Yes, that sounds workable. I’ll look for letters from a solicitor, bank, or anyone who may have held the will.
